## Summary

Describe the user or system outcome and the intentionally excluded scope.

## Acceptance criteria

- Linked issue or acceptance criteria:
- ISO/IEC 25010 characteristics affected:

## Risk and rollback

- Safety, security, privacy, evidence-integrity, or legal-claim impact:
- Rollback plan, or why rollback is not applicable:

## Verification

- [ ] `make verify` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the positive path and relevant fail-closed/negative paths.
- [ ] The PR's acceptance criteria are satisfied or explicitly deferred with an issue.
- [ ] Documentation and an ADR are updated, or the PR explains why neither applies.
- [ ] Observability changes are included, or this change has no runtime operational path.
- [ ] A threat-model review is linked, or this change creates no external attack surface.
- [ ] Schema, infrastructure, and deployment rollback are documented, or none change.
- [ ] No secret, credential, personal data, or real operational water-system data is committed.
- [ ] Evidence receipts remain unsigned and do not claim compliance, safety, water quality, engineering adequacy, or filing approval.
- [ ] Code-owner review covers workflow, dependency, and evidence-integrity changes.

## Reviewer notes

Call out residual risks, follow-up work, and any declared standards N/A rationale.
